prompt.project_info: Create a sophisticated photorealistic winter street-fashion portrait of an approved adult man outside a refined European building.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with neatly styled dark hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a long black overcoat, white shirt, black tie, and black leather gloves. He stands with gloved hands clasped and turns his head slightly aside.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered 9:16 portrait with a black luxury SUV behind, wet cobblestone foreground, white building with dark green shutters and ivy, and a yellow awning with optional supplied typography.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool diffused overcast daylight, soft facial shadows, high global contrast between white architecture and black styling, refined damp winter mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial street photography, 9:16 vertical, sharp subject, medium depth of field, realistic wool, leather, wet stone, vehicle, ivy, and architecture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a sophisticated photorealistic 9:16 winter street-fashion portrait of an approved adult man with neatly styled dark hair and a trimmed beard standing outside a refined European building. Dress him in a long black overcoat, white shirt, black tie, and black leather gloves; show his gloved hands clasped as he turns his head slightly aside. Place a black luxury SUV behind him on wet cobblestones, with white walls, dark green shutters, ivy, and a yellow awning. Use cool diffused overcast daylight, soft facial shadows, realistic textures, and refined editorial mood. Preserve awning typography only when supplied as a text reference.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted vehicle, altered awning text
